data.long_meaning: Jayme is a modern name derived from the Hebrew Yehudit, meaning 'Judahite' or 'little healer'. In Christian tradition, it is associated with Jayme Leverton, a character in the Bible who healed the sick and cared for the poor. The name Jayme carries the meaning “Little Healer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jayme usually hope their child will grow to embody little healer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
